questions.template: Which rock is made from cooled melted rock?
questions.explain: Igneous rock forms when melted rock cools and hardens — like basalt from lava.

questions.template: Which rock is made from squashed layers of sand and mud?
questions.hint: Layers, layers, layers — squeezed for a very long time.
questions.explain: Sedimentary rock is layers of sand, mud and shells pressed together — like sandstone.

questions.template: Soil is mostly a mix of tiny rock bits and…?
questions.hint: What do leaves become when they rot into the ground?
questions.explain: Soil is tiny rock pieces mixed with rotted plant material called humus.

questions.hint: Fossils need gentle layers to rest in, not boiling lava.
questions.explain: Fossils form in sedimentary rock, where layers gently bury and protect them.

questions.template: Marble is limestone changed by heat and pressure. What kind of rock is marble?
questions.explain: Rocks changed by heat and squeezing are metamorphic — marble is transformed limestone.

questions.template: Granite has big sparkly crystals. What does that tell us?
choices: It cooled instantly in the sea
questions.explain: Slow cooling deep underground gives crystals time to grow big — that's granite.

questions.template: Which rock would soak up water: permeable sandstone or hard slate?
questions.hint: Which one has tiny gaps between its grains?
questions.explain: Sandstone is permeable — water sneaks between its sandy grains. Slate keeps water out.

questions.template: A fossil forms when an animal is buried and its bones slowly turn to…?
questions.hint: Fossil hunters use chisels, not saws.
questions.explain: Over millions of years, minerals replace the bone until it becomes stone — a fossil!

questions.template: Lava cools quickly into basalt. Magma cools slowly into granite. What's the difference?
choices: Where it cools: above or below ground
One is not a real rock
questions.hint: Lava is OUTSIDE the volcano; magma stays inside.
questions.explain: Above ground, lava cools fast (small crystals — basalt); underground, magma cools slowly (big crystals — granite).

questions.template: Put fossil formation in order: what happens FIRST?
choices: The animal is buried by sediment
questions.explain: First burial by layers of sediment, then slow turning to stone, and only much later — discovery!
